subject.title: fix: Responses streams mishandle interleaved output items and silent truncation

question: Should all OpenAI and Azure Responses adapters disable SDK retries by default and rely exclusively on OpenClaw's outer retry policy?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes an existing transport default across provider adapters, and tests show explicit zero-budget behavior but do not prove equivalent resilience for every normal caller.

options.title: Prove outer retry ownership
options.body: Keep `maxRetries: 0`, add focused coverage showing OpenAI, Azure, and ChatGPT callers receive the intended outer retries without stacked attempts, and document the ownership invariant near the request builder.

options.title: Preserve adapter defaults
options.body: Only disable SDK retries when the caller explicitly supplies a retry budget, retaining existing default resilience for direct adapter consumers.

recommendation.title: Prove outer retry ownership
recommendation.body: Keep `maxRetries: 0`, add focused coverage showing OpenAI, Azure, and ChatGPT callers receive the intended outer retries without stacked attempts, and document the ownership invariant near the request builder.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest adjacent owner for the OpenAI/Codex transport lifecycle and retry-policy boundary.
